program.name: Mat Core Volume
program.subject: Mat core
program.blurb: Three long Pilates core sessions: the front, the sides, then the back and control.
program.about: Pilates mat work with the core first, always. The abdominal series and teasers for the front; criss-cross, side bends and twists for the obliques; then swimming, swan and rolling for the back and control. Each opens with the hundred. Three days rotate. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
